# Task: Implement Custom Header Injection Filter for Envoy

## Objective
Create a new HTTP filter `envoy.filters.http.custom_header_injection` that injects
configurable headers into requests and/or responses based on route metadata.

## Requirements

1. **Create filter source files**:
   - `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h` — filter class declaration
   - `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.cc` — filter implementation
   - `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/config.h` — factory declaration
   - `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/config.cc` — factory registration

2. **Filter behavior**:
   - Implements `Http::StreamDecoderFilter` (request path) and `Http::StreamEncoderFilter` (response path)
   - Reads header injection rules from filter config
   - Supports both request and response header injection
   - Follows Envoy's filter lifecycle (decodeHeaders, encodeHeaders)

3. **Create test file**:
   - `test/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter_test.cc`

## Key Reference Files
- `source/extensions/filters/http/header_to_metadata/filter.h` — simple header filter pattern
- `source/extensions/filters/http/header_to_metadata/filter.cc` — implementation pattern
- `source/extensions/filters/http/header_to_metadata/config.cc` — factory registration
- `source/extensions/filters/http/common/factory_base.h` — factory base class

## Success Criteria
- Filter header file declares class inheriting from StreamDecoderFilter/StreamEncoderFilter
- Filter implementation has decodeHeaders/encodeHeaders methods
- Factory config file registers the filter
- Follows Envoy naming: envoy.filters.http.custom_header_injection
- Test file exists

#pragma once

#include "envoy/http/filter.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Http {

// A decoder filter which passes all data through with Continue status.
class PassThroughDecoderFilter : public virtual StreamDecoderFilter {
public:
  // Http::StreamFilterBase
  void onDestroy() override {}

  // Http::StreamDecoderFilter
  Http::FilterHeadersStatus decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap&, bool) override {
    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterDataStatus decodeData(Buffer::Instance&, bool) override {
    return Http::FilterDataStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterTrailersStatus decodeTrailers(Http::RequestTrailerMap&) override {
    return Http::FilterTrailersStatus::Continue;
  }
  void setDecoderFilterCallbacks(Http::StreamDecoderFilterCallbacks& callbacks) override {
    decoder_callbacks_ = &callbacks;
  }

protected:
  Http::StreamDecoderFilterCallbacks* decoder_callbacks_{};
};

// An encoder filter which passes all data through with Continue status.
class PassThroughEncoderFilter : public virtual StreamEncoderFilter {
public:
  // Http::StreamFilterBase
  void onDestroy() override {}

  // Http::StreamEncoderFilter
  Http::Filter1xxHeadersStatus encode1xxHeaders(Http::ResponseHeaderMap&) override {
    return Http::Filter1xxHeadersStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterHeadersStatus encodeHeaders(Http::ResponseHeaderMap&, bool) override {
    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterDataStatus encodeData(Buffer::Instance&, bool) override {
    return Http::FilterDataStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterTrailersStatus encodeTrailers(Http::ResponseTrailerMap&) override {
    return Http::FilterTrailersStatus::Continue;
  }
  Http::FilterMetadataStatus encodeMetadata(Http::MetadataMap&) override {
    return Http::FilterMetadataStatus::Continue;
  }
  void setEncoderFilterCallbacks(Http::StreamEncoderFilterCallbacks& callbacks) override {
    encoder_callbacks_ = &callbacks;
  }

protected:
  Http::StreamEncoderFilterCallbacks* encoder_callbacks_{};
};

// A filter which passes all data through with Continue status.
class PassThroughFilter : public StreamFilter,
                          public PassThroughDecoderFilter,
                          public PassThroughEncoderFilter {
public:
  // Http::StreamFilterBase
  void onDestroy() override {}
};
} // namespace Http
} // namespace Envoy

    return std::make_unique<ConfigProto>();

    return std::make_unique<RouteConfigProto>();

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/header_mutation/config.h"

#include <memory>

#include "envoy/registry/registry.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace HeaderMutation {

absl::StatusOr<Http::FilterFactoryCb>
HeaderMutationFactoryConfig::createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
    const ProtoConfig& config, const std::string&, DualInfo,
    Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto filter_config = std::make_shared<HeaderMutationConfig>(config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);

  return [filter_config](Http::FilterChainFactoryCallbacks& callbacks) -> void {
    callbacks.addStreamFilter(std::make_shared<HeaderMutation>(filter_config));
  };
}

absl::StatusOr<Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigConstSharedPtr>
HeaderMutationFactoryConfig::createRouteSpecificFilterConfigTyped(
    const PerRouteProtoConfig& proto_config, Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&,
    ProtobufMessage::ValidationVisitor&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto route_config = std::make_shared<PerRouteHeaderMutation>(proto_config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);
  return route_config;
}

using UpstreamHeaderMutationFactoryConfig = HeaderMutationFactoryConfig;

REGISTER_FACTORY(HeaderMutationFactoryConfig, Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory);
REGISTER_FACTORY(UpstreamHeaderMutationFactoryConfig,
                 Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory);

} // namespace HeaderMutation
} // namespace HttpFilters
} // namespace Extensions
} // namespace Envoy

void QueryParameterMutationAppend::mutateQueryParameter(
    Http::Utility::QueryParamsMulti& params, const Formatter::HttpFormatterContext& context,
    const StreamInfo::StreamInfo& stream_info) const {

  switch (action_) {
    PANIC_ON_PROTO_ENUM_SENTINEL_VALUES;
  case ParameterAppendProto::APPEND_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD:
    params.add(key_, formatter_->formatWithContext(context, stream_info));
    return;
  case ParameterAppendProto::ADD_IF_ABSENT: {
    auto iter = params.data().find(key_);
    if (iter == params.data().end()) {
      params.add(key_, formatter_->formatWithContext(context, stream_info));
    }
    break;
  }
  case ParameterAppendProto::OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS: {
    auto iter = params.data().find(key_);
    if (iter != params.data().end()) {
      params.overwrite(key_, formatter_->formatWithContext(context, stream_info));
    }
    break;
  }
  case ParameterAppendProto::OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD:
    params.overwrite(key_, formatter_->formatWithContext(context, stream_info));
    break;
  }
}

Mutations::Mutations(const MutationsProto& config, absl::Status& creation_status) {
  auto request_mutations_or_error = HeaderMutations::create(config.request_mutations());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(request_mutations_or_error.status(), creation_status);
  request_mutations_ = std::move(request_mutations_or_error.value());

  auto response_mutations_or_error = HeaderMutations::create(config.response_mutations());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(response_mutations_or_error.status(), creation_status);
  response_mutations_ = std::move(response_mutations_or_error.value());

  query_query_parameter_mutations_.reserve(config.query_parameter_mutations_size());
  for (const auto& mutation : config.query_parameter_mutations()) {
    if (mutation.has_append()) {
      if (!mutation.remove().empty()) {
        creation_status =
            absl::InvalidArgumentError("Only one of 'append'/'remove can be specified.");
        return;
      }

      if (!mutation.append().has_record()) {
        creation_status = absl::InvalidArgumentError("No record specified for append mutation.");
        return;
      }
      if (!mutation.append().record().value().has_string_value()) {
        creation_status =
            absl::InvalidArgumentError("Only string value is allowed for record value.");
        return;
      }

      auto value_or_error =
          Formatter::FormatterImpl::create(mutation.append().record().value().string_value(), true);
      SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(value_or_error.status(), creation_status);
      query_query_parameter_mutations_.emplace_back(std::make_unique<QueryParameterMutationAppend>(
          mutation.append().record().key(), std::move(value_or_error.value()),
          mutation.append().action()));

    } else if (!mutation.remove().empty()) {
      query_query_parameter_mutations_.emplace_back(
          std::make_unique<QueryParameterMutationRemove>(mutation.remove()));
    } else {
      creation_status = absl::InvalidArgumentError("One of 'append'/'remove' must be specified.");
      return;
    }
  }
}

syntax = "proto3";

package envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_mutation.v3;

import "envoy/config/common/mutation_rules/v3/mutation_rules.proto";
import "envoy/config/core/v3/base.proto";

import "udpa/annotations/status.proto";

option java_package = "io.envoyproxy.envoy.extensions.filters.http.header_mutation.v3";
option java_outer_classname = "HeaderMutationProto";
option java_multiple_files = true;
option go_package = "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/extensions/filters/http/header_mutation/v3;header_mutationv3";
option (udpa.annotations.file_status).package_version_status = ACTIVE;

// [#protodoc-title: Header mutation filter configuration]
// [#extension: envoy.filters.http.header_mutation]

message Mutations {
  // The request mutations are applied before the request is forwarded to the upstream cluster.
  repeated config.common.mutation_rules.v3.HeaderMutation request_mutations = 1;

  // The ``path`` header query parameter mutations are applied after ``request_mutations`` and before the request
  // is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain.
  repeated config.core.v3.KeyValueMutation query_parameter_mutations = 3;

  // The response mutations are applied before the response is sent to the downstream client.
  repeated config.common.mutation_rules.v3.HeaderMutation response_mutations = 2;
}

// Per route configuration for the header mutation filter.
message HeaderMutationPerRoute {
  Mutations mutations = 1;
}

// Configuration for the header mutation filter. The mutation rules in the filter configuration will
// always be applied first and then the per-route mutation rules, if both are specified.
message HeaderMutation {
  Mutations mutations = 1;

  // If per route HeaderMutationPerRoute config is configured at multiple route levels, header mutations
  // at all specified levels are evaluated. By default, the order is from most specific (i.e. route entry level)
  // to least specific (i.e. route configuration level). Later header mutations may override earlier mutations.
  //
  // This order can be reversed by setting this field to true. In other words, most specific level mutation
  // is evaluated last.
  bool most_specific_header_mutations_wins = 2;
}

package envoy.extensions.filters.http.set_metadata.v3;

import "google/protobuf/any.proto";
import "google/protobuf/struct.proto";

// [#protodoc-title: Set-Metadata Filter]
//
// This filters adds or updates dynamic metadata with static data.
//
// [#extension: envoy.filters.http.set_metadata]

message Metadata {
  // The metadata namespace.
  string metadata_namespace = 1 [(validate.rules).string = {min_len: 1}];

  // Allow the filter to overwrite or merge with an existing value in the namespace.
  bool allow_overwrite = 2;

  // The value to place at the namespace. If ``allow_overwrite``, this will
  // overwrite or merge with any existing values in that namespace. See
  // :ref:`the filter documentation <config_http_filters_set_metadata>` for
  // more information on how this value is merged with potentially existing
  // ones if ``allow_overwrite`` is configured. Only one of ``value`` and
  // ``typed_value`` may be set.
  google.protobuf.Struct value = 3;

  // The value to place at the namespace. If ``allow_overwrite``, this will
  // overwrite any existing values in that namespace. Only one of ``value`` and
  // ``typed_value`` may be set.
  google.protobuf.Any typed_value = 4;
}

message Config {
  // The metadata namespace.
  // This field is deprecated; please use ``metadata`` as replacement.
  string metadata_namespace = 1
      [deprecated = true, (envoy.annotations.deprecated_at_minor_version) = "3.0"];

  // The untyped value to update the dynamic metadata namespace with. See
  // :ref:`the filter documentation <config_http_filters_set_metadata>` for
  // more information on how this value is merged with potentially existing
  // ones.
  // This field is deprecated; please use ``metadata`` as replacement.
  google.protobuf.Struct value = 2
      [deprecated = true, (envoy.annotations.deprecated_at_minor_version) = "3.0"];

  // Defines changes to be made to dynamic metadata.
  repeated Metadata metadata = 3;
}

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/header_mutation/config.h"

#include <memory>

#include "envoy/registry/registry.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace HeaderMutation {

absl::StatusOr<Http::FilterFactoryCb>
HeaderMutationFactoryConfig::createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
    const ProtoConfig& config, const std::string&, DualInfo,
    Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto filter_config = std::make_shared<HeaderMutationConfig>(config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);

  return [filter_config](Http::FilterChainFactoryCallbacks& callbacks) -> void {
    callbacks.addStreamFilter(std::make_shared<HeaderMutation>(filter_config));
  };
}

absl::StatusOr<Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigConstSharedPtr>
HeaderMutationFactoryConfig::createRouteSpecificFilterConfigTyped(
    const PerRouteProtoConfig& proto_config, Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&,
    ProtobufMessage::ValidationVisitor&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto route_config = std::make_shared<PerRouteHeaderMutation>(proto_config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);
  return route_config;
}

using UpstreamHeaderMutationFactoryConfig = HeaderMutationFactoryConfig;

REGISTER_FACTORY(HeaderMutationFactoryConfig, Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory);
REGISTER_FACTORY(UpstreamHeaderMutationFactoryConfig,
                 Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory);

} // namespace HeaderMutation
} // namespace HttpFilters
} // namespace Extensions
} // namespace Envoy

struct HeadersToAddEntry {
  static absl::StatusOr<std::unique_ptr<HeadersToAddEntry>>
  create(const HeaderValue& header_value, HeaderAppendAction append_action) {
    absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
    auto ret = std::unique_ptr<HeadersToAddEntry>(
        new HeadersToAddEntry(header_value, append_action, creation_status));
    RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(creation_status);
    return ret;
  }
  static absl::StatusOr<std::unique_ptr<HeadersToAddEntry>>
  create(const HeaderValueOption& header_value_option) {
    absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
    auto ret = std::unique_ptr<HeadersToAddEntry>(
        new HeadersToAddEntry(header_value_option, creation_status));
    RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(creation_status);
    return ret;
  }

  std::string original_value_;
  Formatter::FormatterPtr formatter_;
  HeaderAppendAction append_action_;
  // Keep small members (bools and enums) at the end of class, to reduce alignment overhead.
  bool add_if_empty_ = false;

protected:
  HeadersToAddEntry(const HeaderValue& header_value, HeaderAppendAction append_action,
                    absl::Status& creation_status);
  HeadersToAddEntry(const HeaderValueOption& header_value_option, absl::Status& creation_status);
};

*
 * @return The route config if found. nullptr if not found. The returned
 * pointer's lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
const ConfigType* resolveMostSpecificPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  static_assert(std::is_base_of<Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig, ConfigType>::value,
                "ConfigType must be a subclass of Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig");
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);
  return dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(callbacks->mostSpecificPerFilterConfig());
}

/**
 * Return all the available per route filter configs.
 *
 * @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

class DualFactoryBase : public CommonFactoryBase<ConfigProto, RouteConfigProto>,
                        public Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory,
                        public Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory {
public:
  DualFactoryBase(const std::string& name)
      : CommonFactoryBase<ConfigProto, RouteConfigProto>(name) {}

  struct DualInfo {
    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::UpstreamFactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(true) {}
    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(false) {}
    Init::Manager& init_manager;
    Stats::Scope& scope;
    bool is_upstream;
  };

  absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProto(const Protobuf::Message& proto_config,
                               const std::string& stats_prefix,
                               Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
                                                 proto_config, context.messageValidationVisitor()),
                                             stats_prefix, DualInfo(context),
                                             context.serverFactoryContext());
  }

  absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProto(const Protobuf::Message& proto_config,
                               const std::string& stats_prefix,
                               Server::Configuration::UpstreamFactoryContext& context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
        MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
            proto_config, context.serverFactoryContext().messageValidationVisitor()),
        stats_prefix, DualInfo(context), context.serverFactoryContext());
  }

  virtual absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(const ConfigProto& proto_config,
                                    const std::string& stats_prefix, DualInfo info,
                                    Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext& context) PURE;

  // This method is for dual filter to create filter from server context when it is configured
  // in downstream. It won't be called if a dual filter is in upstream.
  Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContext(
      const Protobuf::Message& proto_config, const std::string& stats_prefix,
      Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext& server_context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContextTyped(
        MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
            proto_config, server_context.messageValidationVisitor()),
        stats_prefix, server_context);
  }

private:
  virtual Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb
  createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContextTyped(const ConfigProto&, const std::string&,
                                                     Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&) {
    ExceptionUtil::throwEnvoyException(
        "DualFactoryBase: creating filter factory from server factory context is not supported");
    return nullptr;
  }
};

#pragma once

#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>

#include "source/common/common/assert.h"

namespace Envoy {

// This is a workaround to allow an exceptionless Envoy Mobile build while we
// have not finished plumbing Satus/StatusOr<> based error handling, so
// hard-failing instead. See
// (https://github.com/envoyproxy/envoy-mobile/issues/176)
// for example error handling PRs.
// TODO(alyssawilk) finish up error handling and remove this.
#ifdef ENVOY_DISABLE_EXCEPTIONS
#define throwEnvoyExceptionOrPanic(x) PANIC(x)
#define throwExceptionOrPanic(x, y) PANIC(y)
#else
#define throwEnvoyExceptionOrPanic(x) throw ::Envoy::EnvoyException(x)
#define throwExceptionOrPanic(y, x) throw y(x)
#endif

/**
 * Base class for all envoy exceptions.
 */
class EnvoyException : public std::runtime_error {
public:
  EnvoyException(const std::string& message) : std::runtime_error(message) {}
};

#define SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(check_status, set_status)                                         \
  if (const absl::Status temp_status = check_status; !temp_status.ok()) {                          \
    set_status = temp_status;                                                                      \
    return;                                                                                        \
  }

#define THROW_IF_NOT_OK_REF(status)                                                                \
  do {                                                                                             \
    if (!(status).ok()) {                                                                          \
      throwEnvoyExceptionOrPanic(std::string((status).message()));                                 \
    }                                                                                              \
  } while (0)

// Simple macro to handle bridging functions which return absl::StatusOr, and
// functions which throw errors.
#define THROW_IF_NOT_OK(status_fn)                                                                 \
  do {                                                                                             \
    const absl::Status status = (status_fn);                                                       \
    THROW_IF_NOT_OK_REF(status);                                                                   \
  } while (0)

#define RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(variable)                                                             \
  if (const absl::Status& temp_status = variable; !temp_status.ok()) {                             \
    return temp_status;                                                                            \
  }

// Make sure this works for functions without calling the function twice as well.
#define RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(status_fn)                                                                \
  if (absl::Status temp_status = (status_fn); !temp_status.ok()) {                                 \
    return temp_status;                                                                            \
  }

// This macro is used to return from a function directly if the status is not ok
// without returning a status value.
#define RETURN_ONLY_IF_NOT_OK_REF(variable)                                                        \
  if (!variable.ok()) {                                                                            \
    return;                                                                                        \
  }

template <class Type> Type returnOrThrow(absl::StatusOr<Type> type_or_error) {
  THROW_IF_NOT_OK_REF(type_or_error.status());
  return std::move(type_or_error.value());
}

#define THROW_OR_RETURN_VALUE(expression, type) ::Envoy::returnOrThrow<type>(expression)

} // namespace Envoy

// [#protodoc-title: Header mutation filter configuration]
// [#extension: envoy.filters.http.header_mutation]

message Mutations {
  // The request mutations are applied before the request is forwarded to the upstream cluster.
  repeated config.common.mutation_rules.v3.HeaderMutation request_mutations = 1;

  // The ``path`` header query parameter mutations are applied after ``request_mutations`` and before the request
  // is forwarded to the next filter in the filter chain.
  repeated config.core.v3.KeyValueMutation query_parameter_mutations = 3;

  // The response mutations are applied before the response is sent to the downstream client.
  repeated config.common.mutation_rules.v3.HeaderMutation response_mutations = 2;
}

// Per route configuration for the header mutation filter.
message HeaderMutationPerRoute {
  Mutations mutations = 1;
}

// Configuration for the header mutation filter. The mutation rules in the filter configuration will
// always be applied first and then the per-route mutation rules, if both are specified.
message HeaderMutation {
  Mutations mutations = 1;

  // If per route HeaderMutationPerRoute config is configured at multiple route levels, header mutations
  // at all specified levels are evaluated. By default, the order is from most specific (i.e. route entry level)
  // to least specific (i.e. route configuration level). Later header mutations may override earlier mutations.
  //
  // This order can be reversed by setting this field to true. In other words, most specific level mutation
  // is evaluated last.
  bool most_specific_header_mutations_wins = 2;
}

{
  "thought": "Now I have a clear picture of how to implement the filter. Let me design the filter:\n\n1. `FilterConfig` - holds global `HeaderParser` instances for request and response headers\n2. `PerRouteFilterConfig` - holds per-route `HeaderParser` instances, extends `Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig`\n3. `CustomHeaderInjectionFilter` - the actual filter, extends `PassThroughFilter`\n   - In `decodeHeaders`: apply global request headers, then per-route request headers\n   - In `encodeHeaders`: apply global response headers, then per-route response headers\n\nKey design decisions:\n- Use `Router::HeaderParser` for header injection (supports format strings, append actions)\n- Use `Http::Utility::resolveMostSpecificPerFilterConfig` to get per-route config\n- Use `THROW_OR_RETURN_VALUE` for HeaderParser::configure in constructors (since constructors can't return StatusOr)\n- Use `absl::StatusOr` for factory methods\n\nFor the filter constructor, I need to handle the case where `HeaderParser::configure` might fail. Looking at the local_ratelimit pattern, they use `THROW_OR_RETURN_VALUE` in the constructor initializer list. But the header_mutation filter uses `absl::Status& creation_status` pattern. Let me use the creation_status pattern since it's more modern.\n\nActually, looking at the header_mutation filter more carefully:\n\n```cpp\nHeaderMutationConfig(const ProtoConfig& config, absl::Status& creation_status);\n```\n\nAnd in the factory:\n```cpp\nauto filter_config = std::make_shared<HeaderMutationConfig>(config, creation_status);\nRETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);\n```\n\nI'll use the same pattern for FilterConfig and PerRouteFilterConfig.\n\nFor the filter itself, it just takes a `std::shared_ptr<FilterConfig>` and doesn't need error handling in the constructor.\n\nLet me look at how header_mutation.h/cc are structured to model the filter implementation."
}

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

#include "envoy/extensions/filters/http/header_mutation/v3/header_mutation.pb.h"
#include "envoy/http/query_params.h"

#include "source/common/common/logger.h"
#include "source/common/formatter/substitution_formatter.h"
#include "source/common/http/header_mutation.h"
#include "source/common/http/utility.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace HeaderMutation {

using ProtoConfig = envoy::extensions::filters::http::header_mutation::v3::HeaderMutation;
using PerRouteProtoConfig =
    envoy::extensions::filters::http::header_mutation::v3::HeaderMutationPerRoute;
using MutationsProto = envoy::extensions::filters::http::header_mutation::v3::Mutations;
using ParameterMutationProto = envoy::config::core::v3::KeyValueMutation;
using ParameterAppendProto = envoy::config::core::v3::KeyValueAppend;

/**
 * Interface for mutating query parameters.
 */
class QueryParameterMutation {
public:
  virtual ~QueryParameterMutation() = default;

  /**
   * Mutate the query parameters.
   * @param params the query parameters to mutate.
   * @param context the formatter context.
   * @param stream_info the stream info.
   */
  virtual void mutateQueryParameter(Http::Utility::QueryParamsMulti& params,
                                    const Formatter::HttpFormatterContext& context,
                                    const StreamInfo::StreamInfo& stream_info) const PURE;

  "file_text": "#include \"source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h\"\n\n#include \"source/common/http/utility.h\"\n\nnamespace Envoy {\nnamespace Extensions {\nnamespace HttpFilters {\nnamespace CustomHeaderInjection {\n\nFilterConfig::FilterConfig(const ProtoConfig& config, absl::Status& creation_status) {\n  auto req_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.request_headers_to_add());\n  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(req_parser.status(), creation_status);\n  request_headers_parser_ = std::move(req_parser.value());\n\n  auto resp_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.response_headers_to_add());\n  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(resp_parser.status(), creation_status);\n  response_headers_parser_ = std::move(resp_parser.value());\n}\n\nPerRouteFilterConfig::PerRouteFilterConfig(const PerRouteProtoConfig& config,\n                                           absl::Status& creation_status) {\n  auto req_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.request_headers_to_add());\n  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(req_parser.status(), creation_status);\n  request_headers_parser_ = std::move(req_parser.value());\n\n  auto resp_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.response_headers_to_add());\n  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(resp_parser.status(), creation_status);\n  response_headers_parser_ = std::move(resp_parser.value());\n}\n\nvoid CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::initializeRouteConfigs(Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {\n  if (route_configs_initialized_) {\n    return;\n  }\n  route_configs_initialized_ = true;\n  // getAllPerFilterConfig returns configs in ascending order of specificity:\n  // route table → virtual host → route entry. Applying them in this order means\n  // the most specific entry is evaluated last and its values win.\n  route_configs_ = Http::Utility::getAllPerFilterConfig<PerRouteFilterConfig>(callbacks);\n}\n\nHttp::FilterHeadersStatus\nCustomHeaderInjectionFilter::decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap& headers, bool) {\n  config_->requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());\n\n  initializeRouteConfigs(decoder_callbacks_);\n  for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {\n    route_config.requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers,\n                                                        decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());\n  }\n\n  return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;\n}\n\nHttp::FilterHeadersStatus\nCustomHeaderInjectionFilter::encodeHeaders(Http::ResponseHeaderMap& headers, bool) {\n  config_->responseHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());\n\n  // If a local reply was sent before decodeHeaders ran, route configs will not yet be\n  // initialized. initializeRouteConfigs is idempotent, so calling it here is safe.\n  initializeRouteConfigs(encoder_callbacks_);\n  for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {\n    route_config.responseHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers,\n                                                         encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());\n  }\n\n  return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;\n}\n\n} // namespace CustomHeaderInjection\n} // namespace HttpFilters\n} // namespace Extensions\n} // namespace Envoy\n"

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::~MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks() = default;

void MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::sendLocalReply_(
    Code code, absl::string_view body,
    std::function<void(ResponseHeaderMap& headers)> modify_headers,
    const absl::optional<Grpc::Status::GrpcStatus> grpc_status, absl::string_view details) {
  Utility::sendLocalReply(
      stream_destroyed_,
      Utility::EncodeFunctions{
          nullptr, nullptr,
          [this, modify_headers, details](ResponseHeaderMapPtr&& headers, bool end_stream) -> void {
            if (modify_headers != nullptr) {
              modify_headers(*headers);
            }
            encodeHeaders(std::move(headers), end_stream, details);
          },
          [this](Buffer::Instance& data, bool end_stream) -> void {
            encodeData(data, end_stream);
          }},
      Utility::LocalReplyData{is_grpc_request_, code, body, grpc_status, is_head_request_});
}

MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks() {
  initializeMockStreamFilterCallbacks(*this);
  ON_CALL(*this, encodingBuffer()).WillByDefault(Invoke(&buffer_, &Buffer::InstancePtr::get));
  ON_CALL(*this, activeSpan()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(active_span_));
  ON_CALL(*this, tracingConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Return(makeOptRef<const Tracing::Config>(tracing_config_)));
  ON_CALL(*this, scope()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(scope_));

  ON_CALL(*this, mostSpecificPerFilterConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> const Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig* {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return nullptr;
        }
        return route->mostSpecificPerFilterConfig("envoy.filter");
      }));
  ON_CALL(*this, perFilterConfigs())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigs {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return {};
        }
        return route->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter");
      }));
}

MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::~MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks() = default;

{

    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::UpstreamFactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(true) {}
    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(false) {}
    Init::Manager& init_manager;
    Stats::Scope& scope;

        stats_prefix, DualInfo(context), context.serverFactoryContext());

    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContextTyped(

            proto_config, server_context.messageValidationVisitor()),
        stats_prefix, server_context);
  }

private:
  virtual Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::~MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks() = default;

void MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::sendLocalReply_(
    Code code, absl::string_view body,
    std::function<void(ResponseHeaderMap& headers)> modify_headers,
    const absl::optional<Grpc::Status::GrpcStatus> grpc_status, absl::string_view details) {
  Utility::sendLocalReply(
      stream_destroyed_,
      Utility::EncodeFunctions{
          nullptr, nullptr,
          [this, modify_headers, details](ResponseHeaderMapPtr&& headers, bool end_stream) -> void {
            if (modify_headers != nullptr) {
              modify_headers(*headers);
            }
            encodeHeaders(std::move(headers), end_stream, details);
          },
          [this](Buffer::Instance& data, bool end_stream) -> void {
            encodeData(data, end_stream);
          }},
      Utility::LocalReplyData{is_grpc_request_, code, body, grpc_status, is_head_request_});
}

MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks() {
  initializeMockStreamFilterCallbacks(*this);
  ON_CALL(*this, encodingBuffer()).WillByDefault(Invoke(&buffer_, &Buffer::InstancePtr::get));
  ON_CALL(*this, activeSpan()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(active_span_));
  ON_CALL(*this, tracingConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Return(makeOptRef<const Tracing::Config>(tracing_config_)));
  ON_CALL(*this, scope()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(scope_));

  ON_CALL(*this, mostSpecificPerFilterConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> const Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig* {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return nullptr;
        }
        return route->mostSpecificPerFilterConfig("envoy.filter");
      }));
  ON_CALL(*this, perFilterConfigs())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigs {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return {};
        }
        return route->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter");
      }));
}

    57	 * applied first, followed by per-route headers in order from least specific to most specific

    59	 */

    31  void CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::initializeRouteConfigs(Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
    32    if (route_configs_initialized_) {
    33      return;
    34    }
    35    route_configs_initialized_ = true;
    36    // getAllPerFilterConfig returns configs in ascending order of specificity:
    37    // route table → virtual host → route entry. Applying them in this order means
    38    // the most specific entry is evaluated last and its values win.
    39    route_configs_ = Http::Utility::getAllPerFilterConfig<PerRouteFilterConfig>(callbacks);
    40  }
    41
    42  Http::FilterHeadersStatus
    43  CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap& headers, bool) {
    44    config_->requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    45
    46    initializeRouteConfigs(decoder_callbacks_);
    47    for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {
    48      route_config.requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers,
    49                                                          decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    50    }
    51
    52    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
    53  }
    54
    55  Http::FilterHeadersStatus
    56  CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::encodeHeaders(Http::ResponseHeaderMap& headers, bool) {
    57    config_->responseHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    58
    59    // If a local reply was sent before decodeHeaders ran, route configs will not yet be
    60    // initialized. initializeRouteConfigs is idempotent, so calling it here is safe.
    61    initializeRouteConfigs(encoder_callbacks_);
    62    for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {
    63      route_config.responseHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers,
    64                                                           encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    65    }
    66
    67    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
    68  }

    72  } // namespace Extensions

    31  void CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::initializeRouteConfigs(Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
    32    if (route_configs_initialized_) {
    33      return;
    34    }
    35    route_configs_initialized_ = true;
    36    // getAllPerFilterConfig returns configs in ascending order of specificity:

    38    // the most specific entry is evaluated last and its values win.
    39    route_configs_ = Http::Utility::getAllPerFilterConfig<PerRouteFilterConfig>(callbacks);

    42  Http::FilterHeadersStatus
    43  CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap& headers, bool) {
    44    config_->requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    45
    46    initializeRouteConfigs(decoder_callbacks_);
    47    for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {
    48      route_config.requestHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers,
    49                                                          decoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    50    }
    51
    52    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;

    55  Http::FilterHeadersStatus

    57    config_->responseHeadersParser().evaluateHeaders(headers, encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());

    61    initializeRouteConfigs(encoder_callbacks_);
    62    for (const PerRouteFilterConfig& route_config : route_configs_) {

    64                                                           encoder_callbacks_->streamInfo());
    65    }
    66

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::~MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks() = default;

void MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::sendLocalReply_(
    Code code, absl::string_view body,
    std::function<void(ResponseHeaderMap& headers)> modify_headers,
    const absl::optional<Grpc::Status::GrpcStatus> grpc_status, absl::string_view details) {
  Utility::sendLocalReply(
      stream_destroyed_,
      Utility::EncodeFunctions{
          nullptr, nullptr,
          [this, modify_headers, details](ResponseHeaderMapPtr&& headers, bool end_stream) -> void {
            if (modify_headers != nullptr) {
              modify_headers(*headers);
            }
            encodeHeaders(std::move(headers), end_stream, details);
          },
          [this](Buffer::Instance& data, bool end_stream) -> void {
            encodeData(data, end_stream);
          }},
      Utility::LocalReplyData{is_grpc_request_, code, body, grpc_status, is_head_request_});
}

MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks() {
  initializeMockStreamFilterCallbacks(*this);
  ON_CALL(*this, encodingBuffer()).WillByDefault(Invoke(&buffer_, &Buffer::InstancePtr::get));
  ON_CALL(*this, activeSpan()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(active_span_));
  ON_CALL(*this, tracingConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Return(makeOptRef<const Tracing::Config>(tracing_config_)));
  ON_CALL(*this, scope()).WillByDefault(ReturnRef(scope_));

  ON_CALL(*this, mostSpecificPerFilterConfig())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> const Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig* {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return nullptr;
        }
        return route->mostSpecificPerFilterConfig("envoy.filter");
      }));
  ON_CALL(*this, perFilterConfigs())
      .WillByDefault(Invoke([this]() -> Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigs {
        auto route = this->route();
        if (route == nullptr) {
          return {};
        }
        return route->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter");
      }));
}

MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::~MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks() = default;

template <class ConfigProto, class RouteConfigProto = ConfigProto>
class DualFactoryBase : public CommonFactoryBase<ConfigProto, RouteConfigProto>,
                        public Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory,
                        public Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory {
public:
  DualFactoryBase(const std::string& name)
      : CommonFactoryBase<ConfigProto, RouteConfigProto>(name) {}

  struct DualInfo {
    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::UpstreamFactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(true) {}
    DualInfo(Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context)
        : init_manager(context.initManager()), scope(context.scope()), is_upstream(false) {}
    Init::Manager& init_manager;
    Stats::Scope& scope;
    bool is_upstream;
  };

  absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProto(const Protobuf::Message& proto_config,
                               const std::string& stats_prefix,
                               Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
                                                 proto_config, context.messageValidationVisitor()),
                                             stats_prefix, DualInfo(context),
                                             context.serverFactoryContext());
  }

  absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProto(const Protobuf::Message& proto_config,
                               const std::string& stats_prefix,
                               Server::Configuration::UpstreamFactoryContext& context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
        MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
            proto_config, context.serverFactoryContext().messageValidationVisitor()),
        stats_prefix, DualInfo(context), context.serverFactoryContext());
  }

  virtual absl::StatusOr<Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb>
  createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(const ConfigProto& proto_config,
                                    const std::string& stats_prefix, DualInfo info,
                                    Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext& context) PURE;

  // This method is for dual filter to create filter from server context when it is configured
  // in downstream. It won't be called if a dual filter is in upstream.
  Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContext(
      const Protobuf::Message& proto_config, const std::string& stats_prefix,
      Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext& server_context) override {
    return createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContextTyped(
        MessageUtil::downcastAndValidate<const ConfigProto&>(
            proto_config, server_context.messageValidationVisitor()),
        stats_prefix, server_context);
  }

private:
  virtual Envoy::Http::FilterFactoryCb
  createFilterFactoryFromProtoWithServerContextTyped(const ConfigProto&, const std::string&,
                                                     Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&) {
    ExceptionUtil::throwEnvoyException(
        "DualFactoryBase: creating filter factory from server factory context is not supported");
    return nullptr;
  }
};

{
  "message": "Task 9 is complete. Here's a precise summary of what was done and why.\n\n---\n\n## Fix: Dual Factory Upstream Registration Pattern\n\n### Problem\n`config.cc` had two `REGISTER_FACTORY` calls using the **same type** (`CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig`):\n\n```cpp\n// BROKEN — duplicate symbol linker error\nREGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig,\n                 Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory);\nREGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig,          // ← same type again\n                 Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory);\n```\n\nThe `REGISTER_FACTORY` macro expands to a static `RegisterFactory<FACTORY, BASE>` variable and a `forceRegister##FACTORY()` function, both named using the **type name** as a token. Instantiating the macro twice with the same type produces two definitions of `forceRegisterCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig()` and `CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig_registered` — a duplicate symbol linker error.\n\n### Fix\n\n**`config.h`** — added a type alias after the class definition, inside the namespace:\n```cpp\nusing UpstreamCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig = CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig;\n```\n\n**`config.cc`** — changed the second `REGISTER_FACTORY` to use the alias:\n```cpp\nREGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig,\n                 Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory);\nREGISTER_FACTORY(UpstreamCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig,   // ← alias, distinct symbol name\n                 Server::Configuration::UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory);\n```\n\n### Why this works\nA type alias is a distinct C++ identifier, so the macro generates uniquely-named symbols (`forceRegisterUpstreamCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig()` and `UpstreamCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig_registered`) while the underlying concrete type is still `CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig`. Both registrations point to the same factory implementation — one entry in the downstream `NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory` registry and one in the upstream `UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory` registry — with no duplicate symbols.\n\n### Canonical reference\nThis is the exact pattern used by `envoy.filters.http.aws_request_signing`:\n- `config.h` line 45: `using UpstreamAwsRequestSigningFilterFactory = AwsRequestSigningFilterFactory;`\n- `config.cc` lines 181–184: `REGISTER_FACTORY(AwsRequestSigningFilterFactory, NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory)` + `REGISTER_FACTORY(UpstreamAwsRequestSigningFilterFactory, UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory)`\n\n---\n\n### All tasks complete — full file inventory\n\n| File | Status |\n|------|--------|\n| `api/envoy/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/v3/custom_header_injection.proto` | ✅ |\n| `api/envoy/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/v3/BUILD` | ✅ |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h` | ✅ |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.cc` | ✅ |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/config.h` | ✅ fixed |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/config.cc` | ✅ fixed |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/BUILD` | ✅ |\n| `test/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter_test.cc` | ✅ |\n| `test/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/BUILD` | ✅ |\n| `source/extensions/filters/http/well_known_names.h` | ✅ |\n| `source/extensions/extensions_metadata.yaml` | ✅ |"

// Global filter configuration for the custom header injection filter.
// Headers specified here are applied to every request or response that passes
// through the filter chain, before any per-route overrides are applied.
message CustomHeaderInjection {
  // Headers to inject into the downstream request before forwarding to the upstream.
  // Supports all ``HeaderValueOption`` append actions (e.g. ``APPEND_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD``,
  // ``OVERWRITE_IF_EXISTS_OR_ADD``, ``ADD_IF_ABSENT``).
  repeated config.core.v3.HeaderValueOption request_headers_to_add = 1;

  // Headers to inject into the upstream response before forwarding to the downstream client.
  // Supports all ``HeaderValueOption`` append actions.
  repeated config.core.v3.HeaderValueOption response_headers_to_add = 2;
}

// Per-route configuration for the custom header injection filter.
// When present on a route, virtual host, or route configuration, these headers
// are injected in addition to (and after) the global filter headers.

  // Per-route request headers to inject. Applied after global request headers.

  Router::HeaderParserPtr response_headers_parser_;
};

 * filter configuration for a specific route, virtual host, or route table entry.

  const Router::HeaderParser& responseHeadersParser() const { return *response_headers_parser_; }

  Router::HeaderParserPtr response_headers_parser_;
};

namespace Envoy {

namespace CustomHeaderInjection {

FilterConfig::FilterConfig(const ProtoConfig& config, absl::Status& creation_status) {
  auto req_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.request_headers_to_add());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(req_parser.status(), creation_status);
  request_headers_parser_ = std::move(req_parser.value());

  auto resp_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.response_headers_to_add());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(resp_parser.status(), creation_status);
  response_headers_parser_ = std::move(resp_parser.value());
}

PerRouteFilterConfig::PerRouteFilterConfig(const PerRouteProtoConfig& config,
                                           absl::Status& creation_status) {
  auto req_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.request_headers_to_add());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(req_parser.status(), creation_status);
  request_headers_parser_ = std::move(req_parser.value());

  auto resp_parser = Router::HeaderParser::configure(config.response_headers_to_add());
  SET_AND_RETURN_IF_NOT_OK(resp_parser.status(), creation_status);
  response_headers_parser_ = std::move(resp_parser.value());
}

void CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::initializeRouteConfigs(Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  if (route_configs_initialized_) {
    return;
  }
  route_configs_initialized_ = true;
  // getAllPerFilterConfig returns configs in ascending order of specificity:
  // route table → virtual host → route entry. Applying them in this order means
  // the most specific entry is evaluated last and its values win.
  route_configs_ = Http::Utility::getAllPerFilterConfig<PerRouteFilterConfig>(callbacks);
}

absl::StatusOr<Http::FilterFactoryCb>
CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig::createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
    const ProtoConfig& proto_config, const std::string&, DualInfo,
    Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto filter_config = std::make_shared<FilterConfig>(proto_config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);

  return [filter_config](Http::FilterChainFactoryCallbacks& callbacks) -> void {
    callbacks.addStreamFilter(std::make_shared<CustomHeaderInjectionFilter>(filter_config));
  };
}

absl::StatusOr<Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfigConstSharedPtr>
CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig::createRouteSpecificFilterConfigTyped(
    const PerRouteProtoConfig& proto_config, Server::Configuration::ServerFactoryContext&,
    ProtobufMessage::ValidationVisitor&) {
  absl::Status creation_status = absl::OkStatus();
  auto route_config = std::make_shared<PerRouteFilterConfig>(proto_config, creation_status);
  RETURN_IF_NOT_OK_REF(creation_status);
  return route_config;
}

  EXPECT_TRUE(status.ok()) << status.message();

}

#pragma once

#include "envoy/http/filter.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Http {

// A decoder filter which passes all data through with Continue status.
class PassThroughDecoderFilter : public virtual StreamDecoderFilter {
public:
  // Http::StreamFilterBase
  void onDestroy() override {}

  // Http::StreamDecoderFilter
  Http::FilterHeadersStatus decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap&, bool) override {
    return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
  }

template <class ConfigType>

                "ConfigType must be a subclass of Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig");

1. `FilterConfig` - holds global `HeaderParser` instances for request and response headers
2. `PerRouteFilterConfig` - holds per-route `HeaderParser` instances, extends `Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig`
3. `CustomHeaderInjectionFilter` - the actual filter, extends `PassThroughFilter`
   - In `decodeHeaders`: apply global request headers, then per-route request headers
   - In `encodeHeaders`: apply global response headers, then per-route response headers

I am thinking...: Now I have a very clear picture. The `header_mutation` filter uses a custom `HeaderMutations` class (from `source/common/http/header_mutation.h`) which is different from `Router::HeaderParser`. 

For our `custom_header_injection` filter, we're using `config.core.v3.HeaderValueOption` directly (like `local_ratelimit` does), so we should use `Router::HeaderParser::configure()` which accepts `Protobuf::RepeatedPtrField<HeaderValueOption>`.

The key difference from `header_mutation`:
- `header_mutation` uses `config.common.mutation_rules.v3.HeaderMutation` (which supports remove + append)
- Our filter uses `config.core.v3.HeaderValueOption` (which only supports add/overwrite, no remove)

This is simpler and more like `local_ratelimit`.

For the filter implementation:
1. `FilterConfig` - holds `Router::HeaderParserPtr` for request and response headers, constructed with `absl::Status& creation_status`
2. `PerRouteFilterConfig : public Router::RouteSpecificFilterConfig` - same pattern
3. `CustomHeaderInjectionFilter : public Http::PassThroughFilter, public Logger::Loggable<Logger::Id::filter>`

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

I am thinking...: There's a subtle issue I need to think through carefully.

In `filter.cc`, `initializeRouteConfigs` takes a `Http::StreamFilterCallbacks*` and calls `Http::Utility::getAllPerFilterConfig<PerRouteFilterConfig>(callbacks)`.

`getAllPerFilterConfig` calls `callbacks->perFilterConfigs()` (no arguments).

In the mock:
- `MockStreamDecoderFilterCallbacks::perFilterConfigs()` delegates to `route->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter")`
- `MockStreamEncoderFilterCallbacks::perFilterConfigs()` delegates to `route->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter")`

So when `initializeRouteConfigs(decoder_callbacks_)` is called, it calls `decoder_callbacks_->perFilterConfigs()` which calls `decoder_callbacks.route_->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter")`.

When `initializeRouteConfigs(encoder_callbacks_)` is called (in the encode-only path), it calls `encoder_callbacks_->perFilterConfigs()` which calls `encoder_callbacks.route_->perFilterConfigs("envoy.filter")`.

So the `EncodeOnlyPathInitializesRouteConfigs` test correctly sets up `EXPECT_CALL(*encoder_callbacks.route_, perFilterConfigs(_))` because `initializeRouteConfigs` is called with `encoder_callbacks_` in `encodeHeaders`.

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

```cpp
using UpstreamAdmissionControlFilterFactory = AdmissionControlFilterFactory;
```

And then register both:

* @param callbacks The stream filter callbacks to check for route configs.
 *
 * @return The all available per route config. The returned pointers are guaranteed to be non-null
 * and their lifetime is the same as the matched route.
 */
template <class ConfigType>
absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4>
getAllPerFilterConfig(const Http::StreamFilterCallbacks* callbacks) {
  ASSERT(callbacks != nullptr);

  absl::InlinedVector<std::reference_wrapper<const ConfigType>, 4> all_configs;

  for (const auto* config : callbacks->perFilterConfigs()) {
    const ConfigType* typed_config = dynamic_cast<const ConfigType*>(config);
    if (typed_config == nullptr) {
      ENVOY_LOG_MISC(debug, "Failed to retrieve the correct type of route specific filter config");
      continue;
    }
    all_configs.push_back(*typed_config);
  }

  return all_configs;
}

The issue with `REGISTER_FACTORY` is that the macro creates:
1. A function `forceRegister##FACTORY()` 
2. A static variable `FACTORY##_registered`

If we call `REGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig, NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory)` and `REGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig, UpstreamHttpFilterConfigFactory)`, we'd get:
- `forceRegisterCustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig()` defined twice → duplicate symbol error
- `CustomHeaderInjectionFactoryConfig_registered` defined twice → duplicate symbol error

a sub-struct field into a vector of HeaderEntry.\nstd::vector<HeaderEntry>\nparseHeaderEntries(const ProtobufWkt::Struct& proto_config, const std::string& field_name) {\n  std::vector<HeaderEntry> entries;\n  const auto& fields = proto_config.fields();\n  const auto it = fields.find(field_name);\n  if (it == fields.end()) {\n    return entries;\n  }\n  if (it->second.kind_case() != ProtobufWkt::Value::kStructValue) {\n    return entries;\n  }\n  for (const auto& kv : it->second.struct_value().fields()) {\n    if (kv.second.kind_case() == ProtobufWkt::Value::kStringValue) {\n      entries.push_back({kv.first, kv.second.string_value()});\n    }\n  }\n  return entries;\n}\n\n} // namespace\n\nHttp::FilterFactoryCb CustomHeaderInjectionConfig::createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(\n    const ProtobufWkt::Struct& proto_config, const std::string&,\n    Server::Configuration::FactoryContext&) {\n  auto request_headers = parseHeaderEntries(proto_config, \"request_headers_to_add\");\n  auto response_headers = parseHeaderEntries(proto_config, \"response_headers_to_add\");\n\n  auto filter_config = std::make_shared<FilterConfig>(std::move(request_headers),\n                                                      std::move(response_headers));\n\n  return [filter_config](Http::FilterChainFactoryCallbacks& callbacks) -> void {\n    callbacks.addStreamFilter(\n        Http::StreamFilterSharedPtr{new CustomHeaderInjectionFilter(filter_config)});\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Static registration for the custom_header_injection filter. @see RegisterFactory.\n namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace CustomHeaderInjection {

/**
 * Represents a single header name/value pair to inject.
 */
struct HeaderEntry {
  std::string name;
  std::string value;
};

/**
 * Immutable filter configuration holding the headers to inject into
 * requests and responses.
 */
class FilterConfig {
public:
  FilterConfig(std::vector<HeaderEntry> request_headers_to_add,
               std::vector<HeaderEntry> response_headers_to_add)
      : request_headers_to_add_(std::move(request_headers_to_add)),
        response_headers_to_add_(std::move(response_headers_to_add)) {}

  const std::vector<HeaderEntry>& requestHeadersToAdd() const {
    return request_headers_to_add_;
  }
  const std::vector<HeaderEntry>& responseHeadersToAdd() const {
    return response_headers_to_add_;
  }

private:
  const std::vector<HeaderEntry> request_headers_to_add_;
  const std::vector<HeaderEntry> response_headers_to_add_;
};

using FilterConfigSharedPtr = std::shared_ptr<FilterConfig>;

 * HTTP filter that injects configurable headers into requests and/or responses.

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h"

#include "envoy/http/header_map.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace CustomHeaderInjection {

CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::CustomHeaderInjectionFilter(FilterConfigSharedPtr config)
    : config_(std::move(config)) {}

Http::FilterHeadersStatus
CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::decodeHeaders(Http::RequestHeaderMap& headers, bool) {
  for (const auto& entry : config_->requestHeadersToAdd()) {
    ENVOY_LOG(debug, "custom_header_injection: adding request header '{}': '{}'", entry.name,
              entry.value);
    headers.addCopy(Http::LowerCaseString(entry.name), entry.value);
  }
  return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
}

void CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::setDecoderFilterCallbacks(
    Http::StreamDecoderFilterCallbacks& callbacks) {
  decoder_callbacks_ = &callbacks;
}

Http::FilterHeadersStatus
CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::encodeHeaders(Http::ResponseHeaderMap& headers, bool) {
  for (const auto& entry : config_->responseHeadersToAdd()) {
    ENVOY_LOG(debug, "custom_header_injection: adding response header '{}': '{}'", entry.name,
              entry.value);
    headers.addCopy(Http::LowerCaseString(entry.name), entry.value);
  }
  return Http::FilterHeadersStatus::Continue;
}

void CustomHeaderInjectionFilter::setEncoderFilterCallbacks(
    Http::StreamEncoderFilterCallbacks& callbacks) {
  encoder_callbacks_ = &callbacks;
}

} // namespace CustomHeaderInjection
} // namespace HttpFilters
} // namespace Extensions
} // namespace Envoy

#pragma once

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/common/factory_base.h"
#include "source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h"

#include "google/protobuf/struct.pb.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace CustomHeaderInjection {

/**
 * Config registration for the custom_header_injection filter.
 *
 * The filter is configured via a google.protobuf.Struct with two optional
 * sub-structs:
 *   - "request_headers_to_add":  { "<header-name>": "<header-value>", ... }
 *   - "response_headers_to_add": { "<header-name>": "<header-value>", ... }
 *
 * @see NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory.
 */
class CustomHeaderInjectionConfig
    : public Common::FactoryBase<ProtobufWkt::Struct> {
public:
  CustomHeaderInjectionConfig()
      : FactoryBase("envoy.filters.http.custom_header_injection") {}

private:
  Http::FilterFactoryCb createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
      const ProtobufWkt::Struct& proto_config, const std::string& stats_prefix,
      Server::Configuration::FactoryContext& context) override;
};

} // namespace CustomHeaderInjection
} // namespace HttpFilters
} // namespace Extensions
} // namespace Envoy

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/config.h"

#include "envoy/registry/registry.h"

#include "source/extensions/filters/http/custom_header_injection/filter.h"

namespace Envoy {
namespace Extensions {
namespace HttpFilters {
namespace CustomHeaderInjection {

namespace {

// Parse a sub-struct field into a vector of HeaderEntry.
std::vector<HeaderEntry>
parseHeaderEntries(const ProtobufWkt::Struct& proto_config, const std::string& field_name) {
  std::vector<HeaderEntry> entries;
  const auto& fields = proto_config.fields();
  const auto it = fields.find(field_name);
  if (it == fields.end()) {
    return entries;
  }
  if (it->second.kind_case() != ProtobufWkt::Value::kStructValue) {
    return entries;
  }
  for (const auto& kv : it->second.struct_value().fields()) {
    if (kv.second.kind_case() == ProtobufWkt::Value::kStringValue) {
      entries.push_back({kv.first, kv.second.string_value()});
    }
  }
  return entries;
}

} // namespace

Http::FilterFactoryCb CustomHeaderInjectionConfig::createFilterFactoryFromProtoTyped(
    const ProtobufWkt::Struct& proto_config, const std::string&,
    Server::Configuration::FactoryContext&) {
  auto request_headers = parseHeaderEntries(proto_config, "request_headers_to_add");
  auto response_headers = parseHeaderEntries(proto_config, "response_headers_to_add");

  auto filter_config = std::make_shared<FilterConfig>(std::move(request_headers),
                                                      std::move(response_headers));

  return [filter_config](Http::FilterChainFactoryCallbacks& callbacks) -> void {
    callbacks.addStreamFilter(
        Http::StreamFilterSharedPtr{new CustomHeaderInjectionFilter(filter_config)});
  };
}

/**
 * Static registration for the custom_header_injection filter. @see RegisterFactory.
 */
REGISTER_FACTORY(CustomHeaderInjectionConfig, Server::Configuration::NamedHttpFilterConfigFactory);

} // namespace CustomHeaderInjection
} // namespace HttpFilters
} // names...
